identity: ONE original bulky headless crystalline construct, the Corona Bulwark, facing screen right in slightly elevated three-quarter view. Keep the ivory and gold armoured shell, the huge vertical oval blue-violet crystal set in the chest, the radial fan of thick iridescent blue-violet crystal plates around the shoulders and back with a small gold crest on top, TWO large jointed armoured arms ending in heavy shield-shaped fists, and TWO short thick armoured legs with broad clawed feet. No separate head. Exactly two arms and two legs. Preserve the chest crystal, the crystal fan, the fists and the heavy squat proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed scale and centred body. Keep the full crystal fan, both fists and both feet within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated GREEN throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The green background stays the same flat saturated green in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, flashes, beams, sparks, motion trails, particles or extra limbs; the crystals keep only their steady glow. The construct moves at its joints; the shell plates and crystals stay rigid and never bend or morph.

idle_h3_v1.action: A heavy, steady idle that loops. The body rises and settles slowly as if breathing, the shoulders roll, one heavy fist lifts and flexes a little and the crystal fan shifts slightly, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both feet stay planted. No walking and no attack.

move_h3_v1.action: Stomp in place through two complete reciprocal cycles with heavy, short steps. Alternate near and far legs through lift, swing and heavy plant; both knees articulate and each broad foot alternates taking weight and swinging. The body stays centred for engine-driven travel, swaying side to side a little with the arms swinging. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE heavy punch toward screen right. The construct draws the far fist back high behind the crystal fan as the knees bend and the body twists, then steps into a wide lunge and drives that fist straight out to full reach at screen right, pulls the arm back and settles into the original stance. One punch only; no flash or effect at contact.

hit_h3_v1.action: Start rocked back in a flinch, then recover completely. The body rocks back and twists away, the arms swing out and the knees flex, then it rebalances on both feet and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Bring both heavy shield-fists together in front of the chest crystal, bend the knees and crouch low behind them, then hold the closed guard on both planted feet. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A solemn acknowledgement. The construct brings both fists together in front of the chest crystal and bows forward slightly, holds the pose briefly, then opens the arms and straightens back to the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow change or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly and heavily. The knees buckle and the construct sinks forward onto its fists, stays there a moment, then slumps face down flat onto the ground with the arms spread and the crystal fan lying flat, finishing motionless with the chest crystal dark. The same body throughout: no explosion, no shattering, no shrinking and no disappearing.
